newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair expects yield to decline.
newsitem.headline: Swissair expects yield to decline.

text.p: SAir Group expects the yield of its Swissair airline to decline to 14.0 centimes in 1997, but this would be countered by improved productivity, the group said in statements released at a news conference.
In 1996 Swissair's yield, or the revenue obtained per seat kilometre, fell to 14.9 from 16.1 centimes in 1995.
However, Swissair's unit costs were forecast to decline to 9.2 centimes per available seat kilometre from 10.2 in 1996.
The statements also showed that the workforce at Swissair was projected to fall to 7,456 in 1997 from 7,815 in 1996.
Meanwhile, production is projected to rise to 6,202 million tonne kilometres (TKM) from 5,544 in 1996.
Available TKM was projected to rise 27 percent in 1997 to 732,000 per staff member. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
